digest.component_or_area: live Jira DC transport test harness
propositions: test_a_rekeyed_issue_resolves_by_id_and_records_what_the_stale_key_returns fails ~1 in 26 runs when the randomly drawn project key ends in 'Z', because the rekey derivation (replace last char with 'Z') produces an identical key
the derivation new_project_key = jira_dc_project[:-1] + 'Z' does not guarantee a collision-free rename target when the source key already ends in 'Z'
the setup assertion new_project_key != jira_dc_project must be retained as the guard that caught the silent collision instead of allowing a project to be renamed to itself

the fixed derivation must satisfy Jira project key rules (uppercase letters only, length 2-10, no collision for any harness-generated key) and must be proven by a unit test parametrizing all 26 possible final letters
